== Summary ==
'''CardMaker recreation''' of [[Imperial Atrocity (V) (Errata)]], showing the '''PC-E1''' game text. No published card image shows this text. The Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB4-L-imperialatrocity-pre.gif]]) and the Virtual Block 4 release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB4-85-Imperial_Atrocity.png]]) show the original text.

* '''Text source:''' the Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013), Light Side. Icons are drawn as on the printed slips.
* '''PC-E1 text:''' “If you are about to lose Force during opponent’s control phase, deploy on table to reduce loss by 2. Whenever you lose Force during opponent’s control phase (except from a Force drain at a battleground or your card) that loss is cumulatively -1 (to a minimum of 1). Non-[Virtual Block 4] Imperial Atrocity is canceled.”
* '''Made:''' 8 November 2026 with the SWCCG CardMaker (https://swccg.com/cardmaker/, repo billbisco/swccg-cardmaker, STANDARD rev 72): the card's own Virtual Legacy card (GEMP <code>1240_86</code>; printed frame, Decipher art, title, lore, icons and set mark as on the Players Committee card image) with the PC-E1 game text. Holotable size, 745 × 1039.
* '''Not an official image.''' Card art and design © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc.; virtual card text by the Star Wars CCG Players Committee.
